title: The Fretboard
description: A shy music student overcomes self-doubt during a rooftop jam session.
character_reference: a young man with curly red hair, freckles, and a vintage brown leather jacket over a black t-shirt

scenes.narration: My fingers refused to cooperate on the guitar strings while anyone else was in the room listening. Every chord sounded clumsy.
scenes.visual: close up of trembling fingers pressing down on steel guitar frets, shallow depth of field, warm indoor ambient lighting

scenes.narration: I carried the battered acoustic up to the empty roof at dusk, away from all the critical ears downstairs.
scenes.visual: wide shot of a silhouette carrying an acoustic guitar case across a gravel rooftop during a moody sunset with orange and purple skies

scenes.narration: Sitting against the brick wall, I stopped trying to impress an imaginary crowd and just played the melody for myself.
scenes.visual: medium shot of a musician strumming an acoustic guitar while leaning back against a weathered brick wall, soft evening glow on face

scenes.narration: A stray cat wandered over and sat right by my boot, purring in time with the gentle rhythm of the slow blues progression.
scenes.visual: low angle shot focusing on a tabby cat sitting calmly next to a pair of worn canvas sneakers, guitar body visible in upper frame

scenes.narration: For the first time in months, I stopped worrying about making mistakes and just got lost in the music.
scenes.visual: close up of closed eyes and serene expression while fingers expertly slide along the fretboard of a wooden guitar, golden hour light

scenes.narration: Growth happens the moment you stop performing and start expressing. Follow along for more stories.
scenes.visual: cinematic portrait of a musician smiling softly while holding an acoustic guitar under string lights on a cozy balcony at night
